$comment: .screenmap/config.json — mechanical knobs for the deterministic lane. All optional.
$effort: fast | balanced (default) | thorough — token cost and speed vs accuracy. fast: agent only sees screens no flow can reach. balanced: also re-checks routes whose deep link guesses a param. thorough: every screen goes through the agent. Anything you set below wins over the preset.

agent.$comment: provider: claude (default) | codex | gemini | opencode; or command: a bash template run instead ({promptFile} / $SCREENMAP_PROMPT_FILE carry the task), with keyEnv naming the env var it needs. scan overrides the effort preset: unflowed | params | all
